company_name: Herbert Arnold, Glastechnischer Maschinen- und Apparatebau GmbH & Co. KG
semiconductor_relevance: High — the company specializes in equipment for processing silicon ingots, which is critical in semiconductor manufacturing.
summary: Herbert Arnold, Glastechnischer Maschinen- und Apparatebau GmbH & Co. KG focuses on mechanical cutting and grinding processes for silicon ingots used in photovoltaics and semiconductor applications. They offer both standalone machines and custom-tailored complete systems designed to optimize production processes.
